summary: Event calendar with day, week, and month views.
whenToUse: Showing events across multiple dates and navigating between periods.
whenNotToUse: To pick a date use Calendar; for a linear schedule use Agenda.

props.name: events
props.description: Events with CalendarDate dates and an optional inclusive end.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: Overrides the first day of the week derived from the locale.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Message in the day view when there are no events.

keyboard.action: Navigates periods, switches views, and activates interactive events.

accessibility: Uses a table with headers and readable dates, with announcements of the current period.
responsive: Seven-column views scroll within their own container on narrow viewports.
customization: Colors and spacing use the design system tokens.
commonMistakes: Use CalendarDate for time-zone-less dates; an event's end is inclusive.
limits: Does not handle bookings, time zones, recurrence, or persistence.
